problem: The daily GitHub visual-density workflow produced durable screenshot evidence, but without automatic Supabase writeback the existing Loop Assurance receipts would eventually become stale.
root_cause: Execution evidence and assurance authority were connected semantically but lacked an automated provider-to-authority synchronization adapter.
prevention: GitHub remains the test executor and screenshot evidence source.
Supabase polls only successful completed main runs of portal-visual-density.yml and requires the visual-density job itself to be green.
The existing Powerhouse scheduler token protects the sync adapter; no new credential or parallel truth store is introduced.
Successful GitHub evidence refreshes all eight existing loop-assurance stage receipts and the quality event before the canonical assurance refresh runs.
